description_sq: Shitet nje apartament 3+1+3 prane sheshit Skenderbej. Apartamenti ndodhet ne kati e pare teknik. te nje ndertese te ndertuar ne v 2010. title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 3+1+3 NEAR SKENDERBEJ SQUARE
description_en: A 3+1+3 apartment for sale near Skenderbej square. The apartment is located on the technical first floor. of a building built in 2010. The apartment is fully furnished with quality modern furniture and equipment. The apartment consists of 3 bedrooms, 2 of which with en-suite bathrooms and natural ventilation, a functional and separate office, a living room with a cooking and dining area, as well as a balcony. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation, electronic equipment and furniture are of the Miele brand, air conditioning system from Aermec, kitchen with the best quality materials in this field, etc. The apartment is sold furnished as in the photo.
